transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for joining the weekly course-materials meeting. I need to finalize the library reserve plan for the upcoming undergraduate course, and I want to make sure we have all the information we need before I make my final decision. The draft plan currently lists 40 simultaneous digital users, 10 print copies, and scanned PDF files. Before I sign off on this, I'd like to hear from each of you. Instructor, are there any details about the course requirements or enrollment I should know? Copyright librarian, do we have any concerns about the scanned PDFs or licensing? Accessibility coordinator, are there any accessibility issues with the current plan? And bookstore manager, is there anything I should know about the print copies or materials availability?
